sections.text:
Get to know our specialized law firm

LED BY GEMMA BUENO

My Nomad Lawyer is a growing law firm that combines international experience, in-depth knowledge of immigration and investment law, and a comprehensive, personalized approach. Led by Gemma Bueno, an expert immigration lawyer and member of the Immigration Subcommittee of the Malaga Bar Association, we provide reliable and efficient solutions for digital nomads and foreign investors.

Gemma holds the European Lawyer’s Card (CCBE), certifying her status as a recognized lawyer in any EU Member State. This allows her to represent clients before European courts and institutions, ensuring a legal service that meets the highest European standards.
